author: hokiepride44
notes_extra: 30 thousandths off in a SAMMI chamber, as he spelled it. Sub 1/2 MOA at 650-700 yards. FURMAN later wrote there is only one 180 hybrid Berger and that the hunters and targets are VLDs. ColoSms replied: Actually the 180 hybrid target.

author: FURMAN
notes_extra: 0.020 off the lands. He said to work up and that it has worked in several rifles. No velocity in the post.

author: Ryanjac23
notes_extra: He wrote 66.5 to 69 gr. COAL 3.34 in, and a few seated at 3.37 in did not help. 22 in Proof, Defiance action, about 100 rounds. Groups 1.25-1.5 in while Hornady factory ELDMs shot 0.5 in.

author: Ryanjac23
notes_extra: Same rifle. Jump went from about 0.100 in to 0.030 in. Max jam 3.44 in. ES 15 fps, one group 0.61 in. A later trip with the same charge grouped 1.98, 0.74, and 1.25 in. He then found the front action screw under 20 in-lb and had the rifle re-bedded. Those later groups are not a new charge.

author: hdc77
notes_extra: He wrote that his 7 PRC did not like Retumbo. Loaded long. CBTo 2.560 is base-to-ogive, not COAL. One-hole groups on ADG brass.

author: Timgunner
notes_extra: The sentence covers 180 Berger hybrids and VLDs together, so this velocity is not isolated to the hybrid. No charge for the hybrid. ES about 50 fps. No pressure signs. The 69.2 gr Retumbo 0.16 in group in the same post is 180 Berger VLDs and is not stored here. 28 in Shilen.

author: Timgunner
notes_extra: Same post as the Retumbo row. Hybrids and VLDs are named together. Extreme spreads with h1000 were around 12 fps. No charge.

author: 338bigdog
notes_extra: Custom 280ai for F-class. 9-twist Bartlein. Norma fireformed brass. The Barnes 150 TTSX and 180 ELD-M in the same post are other bullets.

author: kev77
notes_extra: He wrote 180 berger hybirds. Nosler brass. 1-9 twist, which he preferred over 1-8. This range is one report, not two charges.

author: lawrence97
notes_extra: Quick powder and seating test with 180 hybrids. He decided to run it at 2990 fps. No charge in this post. Primer pockets go bad at 3040 fps, maybe two firings at 3020 fps.

author: lawrence97
notes_extra: He wrote H831SC. On the edge in 62-70 F and at its limits at 83 F. Lost 3-5 pieces of brass. Same barrel as the 60.5 and 59.5 rows in this post.

author: lawrence97
notes_extra: Under 90 rounds the barrel averaged 2990-3010 fps with 60.5 gns. After it sped up near 90 rounds the same charge shot around 3030-3040 fps. He wrote H831SC.

author: lawrence97
notes_extra: He dropped from 60.5 to 59.5 to stay at 2990 fps after the barrel sped up. He wrote H831SC. Same post as the 60 and 60.5 rows.
